capabilities.reason: Pinned native Agent, sequential/parallel Code tools, HTTP/Workflow tools, parsers, chains, extraction and classification passed on both codecs. Live evidence is limited to one Lite text/tool suite.
Native account operations and account-scoped selectors passed; one current-only live account usage GET passed. Real login and rotating refresh remain unverified.
Both-codec selection, causal post-429 reads, admission failures, deadlines and cancellation passed with synthetic accounts. No real second-account failover was performed.
Native manual actions, caps, invalid-input no-spend cases, 36 separate-process fault points and 32-way contention passed with synthetic providers. Actual earned-allocation effects remain unverified.
Local schema/Zod validation and native parser success, failure, refusal and explicit repair passed on both codecs. One live Lite JSON-schema result passed; the adapter adds no repair generation.
Native memory/filesystem binary input, validation and tool continuation passed on both codecs. One live PNG input passed on Lite; standard-route visual inference remains unverified.
Synthetic PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF generation, native binary storage and HTTP delivery passed. Workflow Tool returns metadata only. No current real-account image generation was performed.
Scoped hints, normalized usage and unchanged default request contracts passed on both codecs. Live cached-token counts were zero; cache hits, retention, pricing and savings are unverified.

Native Chat, Router, Image and downstream reports passed exact counters, profile isolation, partial coverage and finish cleanup. Boundaries, late closes and concurrent aggregation passed; reporting makes no provider request.
Account-scoped Model Selector, shared Simple Memory across Agents/executions and explicit text-only memory budgeting passed. Router memory/history is rejected before inference.
Requires a distributed coordinator; this release rejects queue mode.
No supported subscription wire contract; use explicit native preprocessing/tools.
Pinned source supports edits but lifecycle is outside this finite release.
Discovery accepts future model IDs only through the two authenticated known codecs.
